name: Sidekiq OSS Ruby Background Jobs
free_limit: LGPLv3-licensed Sidekiq OSS background-job processing for Ruby with retries, Web UI, middleware and scheduling; free open-source core with no software subscription or vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Ruby workers plus Redis, Valkey or Dragonfly and separately funded infrastructure. Sidekiq Pro/Enterprise features are paid. LGPLv3 obligations apply when redistributing Sidekiq; check the license of the chosen datastore.
